nodes.name: WhatsApp Webhook
nodes.notes: Set this URL in your Meta App > WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook. Meta sends a GET with hub.challenge to verify, and POSTs every incoming message/button reply here after that.

nodes.name: Look Up Pending Resume URL
nodes.notes: Reads the 'pending_approvals' table where the main pipeline stored {{$execution.resumeUrl}} just before each Wait node, keyed by your WhatsApp number. Swap this for whatever store you used (Airtable, Postgres, Google Sheets).

nodes.name: Resume Paused Execution
nodes.notes: POSTs the button_id to the stored resumeUrl, which wakes up the exact Wait node that's paused for this person.

nodes.name: Respond 200 OK
nodes.notes: Meta requires a fast 200 response or it will retry/flag the webhook as broken.
